# ZIPFoundation

Upstream: https://github.com/weichsel/ZIPFoundation
Version: 0.9.20, commit 22787ffb59de99e5dc1fbfe80b19c97a904ad48d.
License: MIT; copied Swift sources are unchanged. Apple Compression is used.
Vendored to keep native/offline builds reproducible without a package download.
Project archives use flat regular-file entries only, verified CRCs and SHA-256.
